title: Recon
summary: You show up with curiosity and nothing else. We hand you a shell, a scoreboard, and a challenge that is beatable in twenty minutes.
outcomes: Set up a working Linux environment
Understand how a CTF scoreboard works

title: First Blood
summary: The first flag you find without a hint. It is a small moment and it changes how you read every system afterwards.
outcomes: Solve an unassisted web or crypto challenge
Learn to read a challenge for its intent

title: Pick Your Category
summary: Generalists plateau. You choose a lane — web, pwn, crypto, forensics, reversing or OSINT — and go deep enough to be useful to a team.
outcomes: Commit to a primary CTF category
Work the matching track on the learning ladder

title: Team Play
summary: CTFs are won by division of labour. You get slotted into a squad, learn to hand off cleanly, and stop hoarding half-solved challenges.
outcomes: Compete in an internal Kryptonex CTF
Practise clean handoffs under time pressure
Cover for a category that is not yours

title: Digital Fortress
summary: Eight hours, six categories, colleges from across Pune on one live scoreboard. You either compete in it or you help run it — both teach you a lot.
outcomes: Or author and test a challenge yourself
Operate under a real scoreboard and real clock

title: Give It Back
summary: You write the challenges, run the sessions, and mentor the intake behind you. This is the step that keeps the community alive after you graduate.
outcomes: Author challenges for the next event
Take a council or track-lead role
